name: EL Identification and Placement Notice
description: Notice of the EL identification process and results and the recommended program placement, along with detailed LIEP information, exit criteria, and the right to refuse services with a waiver form.
deadline: within 30 days of the beginning of each school year, or within 14 days of enrollment during the year
quote: Within thirty (30) days of the beginning of each school year, or within fourteen (14) days of enrollment during the school year, the District shall notify parents/guardians of students identified as ELs about the process for identifying their children as an EL, the results of that process, and the recommended program placement.
